title: Who will score the match-winning goal in Portugal's opening fixture of the 2026–27 UEFA Nations League?
background: Portugal enter the competition as defending champions. This question concerns their senior men's team's first league-phase match.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : UEFA's official match report or contemporaneous reporting by Al Jazeera Sport. 
  Resolution : Resolve after Portugal's opening league-phase match in September 2026. The match-winning goal is the winning team's goal that brings its total to one more than the losing team's final total. The answer is the player officially credited with that goal, regardless of which team wins. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The goalscorer's full name. If the match ends in a draw, return “No winning scorer”.
